requirements: Svelte 5 and Node 22, Bun 1.2 or Deno 2 or newer. ESM only.

step.config: Describe the translations your app loads.
step.use: Read them off the instance. The text follows the active locale.

sveltekit.title: Built for SvelteKit
sveltekit.text: Per-request instances on the server, so one visitor's language never reaches another visitor's page.

install.title: One install
install.text: The core and the Curly parser come with it. Nothing else to add, and only one reactive graph.

lazy.title: Loads what a route needs
lazy.text: A loader fires when both its locale and its route match, once per freshness window.

runes.title: One reactive instance
runes.text: Svelte 5 runes instead of stores: properties you read, methods you await.

types.title: Typed keys and payloads
types.text: A schema slot narrows what t() and l() accept, down to each message's parameters.

extensions.title: Extensible
extensions.text: The extensions pipe folds further surfaces onto the instance — Svelte stores, for one.
